newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Market cheers H&M result, share hits high.
newsitem.headline: Market cheers H&M result, share hits high.

text.p: Shares in clothing retailer H&M Hennes & Mauritz AB hit a record high on Monday after the company posted better-than-expected results for the first half of the 1996/97 financial year.

After the result at 0955 GMT the share was trading at 286 crowns ($36.83), up seven percent from its Friday close after reaching a record intra-day high of 293 crowns just after the report was released.
"The result is very positive -- better than everyone had hoped. I think we will see foreign investors coming into the market," one Stockholm-based broker told Reuters.
The broker added that trade in H&M was heavy while elsewhere on the market volumes were thin and there was a lack of news on which to trade.
H&M said its pre-tax profit jumped 63 percent to 1.01 billion crowns for the six months ending May 31 while analysts in a Reuter poll had expected 832 milion on average.
-- Abigail Schmelz, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1003 ($ = 7.763 Swedish Crowns)
